title: Best dental clinics in Buenos Aires

methodology.note: Public-evidence ranking of clinic-scale dental practices in CABA. English is a six-point bonus when an official site, official bilingual claim, or dedicated English patient path is confirmed.

weights.name: Clinical depth
weights.note: Specialty breadth across implants, ortho, aesthetic, endo, surgery, and emergency care.

weights.name: Review strength
weights.note: Google Maps rating and volume, plus Doctoralia or WhatClinic when Google is thin.

weights.name: Technology
weights.note: CBCT, CAD/CAM, intraoral scanners, guided implants, in-house lab.

weights.name: Experience
weights.note: Years, named specialists, teaching or hospital ties.

weights.name: Transparency
weights.note: Clear address, booking path, published services or prices.

weights.name: English access
weights.note: Six-point bonus for official English care; three points for receptionist or review-only English; zero if none.

validation.source: Dedicated clinic research plus official sites, Google Maps, Doctoralia, WhatClinic, Instagram, and expat forums
validation.scope: CABA dental clinics and hospital dental services with enough public evidence to confirm address, booking, and reviews
validation.lastTop5AuditNote: Second-pass search of Maps, Doctoralia, AgendaPro, DentaVacation, and expat lists. Dedicated Composer 2.5 agents scored eight clinics that could have threatened rank 5 (score 71). None reached 71.

excluded.name: Hospital Británico Odontología
excluded.reason: Hospital has odontologists, but no standalone public dental-clinic page with a confirmable CABA consultorio ranking signal.

excluded.name: CEMIC Odontología
excluded.reason: Public notices show the Saavedra dental service was reduced or suspended; not a stable ranking candidate.

excluded.name: Hospital Favaloro Odontología
excluded.reason: Search hits resolve to the Posadas/Misiones hospital, not Fundación Favaloro in CABA.

excluded.name: Dra. Liza Marigo Klein
excluded.reason: English-speaking specialist consultorio, not a clinic-scale practice.

excluded.name: Odontología Blanche / Dental Total / Klas Smile / Alta Odontología
excluded.reason: Appeared in local search or social results, but weaker independent confirmation than the ranked set. Klasmile is San Isidro, not CABA.

excluded.name: Dental System
excluded.reason: Largest institutional miss: five CABA sedes, CAD-CAM labs, and a Recoleta HQ with an OR. Recoleta Google is 2.8 from 540 reviews, so review strength cannot support a top-5 score.

excluded.name: Congreso Dental
excluded.reason: Closest audited near-miss (conservative 68). Strong named team and 4.8/383, but Spanish-only and still below Dental Palermo at 71.

excluded.name: Clínica Dental Dentistry / Dra. Marina Stefano
excluded.reason: Belgrano consultorio still open (4.7/85) with official English pages, but founder Dr. Coerezza now practices in Florida. Conservative score 66.

excluded.name: SM Odontología
excluded.reason: Barrio Norte multi-specialist team with the same 4.9/237 Google profile as Dental Palermo, but no English path and thinner published tech. Conservative score 65.

excluded.name: Dental Art Center / Dental Digital Center
excluded.reason: Operational near Obelisco after a rebrand; mixed English via the lead dentist. Only 4.2/36 Google reviews. Conservative score 60.

excluded.name: Dental Woda
excluded.reason: Recoleta clinic, 4.9/522, Instagram English/Portuguese claim, no official English site. Conservative score 59.

excluded.name: Dental Ciudad / Dental Microcentro
excluded.reason: Two CABA sedes and CAD-CAM marketing, 4.9 on each pin, but staff English is translation-app only. Conservative score 59.

excluded.name: Grupo Rio Dental Studio
excluded.reason: Confirmed Recoleta address (Av. Callao 1234) and iTero scanner. 4.4/62 with polarized reviews. Conservative score 53.

excluded.name: Celedent / Dra. Yaraibelt López
excluded.reason: 4.9/955 Google volume looks marketing-inflated for a floor-5 consultorio. Boutique lead-gen practice, not clinic-scale. Conservative score 26.

excluded.name: IOAT / ODAR / SIACO / Dental Si / Cimadental
excluded.reason: High Maps volume in Microcentro, but ratings in the 3.1–4.2 range. None had the English or review-quality mix needed for a top-5 score.

clinics.name: AM Estética Dental
clinics.fullAddress: Camila O'Gorman 412, Oficina 101, Puerto Madero, C1107DED CABA, Argentina
clinics.bookingLead: WhatsApp for an initial assessment; appointment required.
clinics.bestFor: Porcelain veneers, digital smile design, and a one-trip cosmetic rehab for English-speaking patients.
clinics.notes: Dr. Ariel Merino’s Puerto Madero veneer clinic, with an English site, published USD pricing, and an in-house lab. Private-pay only.
clinics.caution: Not a general dentist. Doctoralia lists no prepagas; expect premium per-veneer pricing.

englishSupport.label: Official English site
englishSupport.evidence: Full /en site with English WhatsApp intake and dental-tourism pages.

clinics.insuranceNote: Private only. No obras sociales or prepagas listed.

clinics.name: SISO Dental
clinics.fullAddress: Av. Sta. Fe 3205 Planta Baja 1, C1425EHI CABA, Argentina
clinics.bookingLead: WhatsApp or phone; same-week slots are common.
clinics.bestFor: A multi-sede private clinic for implants, orthodontics, and aligners, with the strongest Google volume in this list.
clinics.notes: Four CABA sedes — Palermo, Belgrano, Recoleta, Villa Devoto — plus Lomas. Palermo is the ranked pin (4.9 from 823). Official English site.
clinics.caution: Mostly private-pay. Some reviews mention price or rushed visits. Saturday hours differ by sede — confirm before going.

englishSupport.label: Official English site
englishSupport.evidence: Full English site; Palermo reviews and an ExpatsBA post mention English-speaking reception.

clinics.insuranceNote: Private-pay. Aesthetic work is generally not covered by obra social or prepaga.

clinics.name: Dental DAS Group Argentina
clinics.bookingLead: WhatsApp, phone, or the English contact form.
clinics.bestFor: English-speaking medical-tourism patients who want implants, veneers, orthodontics, or same-day emergency care.
clinics.notes: Family clinic run by Drs Gustavo and Marisol Telo. Full English site, on-site CBCT, and an in-house lab. Built for international patients.
clinics.caution: Private medical-tourism clinic. No Argentine prepaga list. Phone numbers on the site do not always match.

englishSupport.label: Official English care
englishSupport.evidence: Full English website and emergency page stating they are English-speaking dentists.

clinics.insuranceNote: Private and international/travel insurance. No Argentine prepagas advertised.

clinics.name: Dra. María Verónica Pacheco y Equipo
clinics.bookingLead: Doctoralia first; WhatsApp and phone also work.
clinics.bestFor: A high-volume Doctoralia team for implants, endodontics, and rehab, including OSDE patients.
clinics.notes: MVP Odontología near Tribunales. Dra. Pacheco leads a multi-dentist team; Doctoralia shows 825 opinions. English is listed on official profiles.
clinics.caution: Prepaga acceptance varies by sede and service. Street parking near Tribunales is difficult.

englishSupport.label: Official English listed
englishSupport.evidence: Doctoralia and the official site list English (and Portuguese) as spoken languages.

clinics.insuranceNote: Doctoralia lists OSDE, OSPE, APSOT, and Caja de Abogados at Córdoba 1364. Confirm the plan.

clinics.name: Dental Palermo
clinics.bookingLead: WhatsApp to schedule; website form also works.
clinics.bestFor: Digital adhesive dentistry, whitening, and preventive work with a dentist who speaks English.
clinics.notes: Solo practice of Dr. Claudio Sorrentino (UBA 1992) with a fully digital workflow. Morning hours only.
clinics.caution: Private-only. The consultorio is inside a residential building and can be hard to find from the street.

englishSupport.label: Dentist speaks English
englishSupport.evidence: WhatClinic lists English; Google and WhatClinic reviews confirm Dr. Sorrentino speaks English. Site is Spanish-only.

clinics.insuranceNote: Private pay only. WhatClinic lists HTH Worldwide international dental plans.

clinics.name: Zuro Dental
clinics.fullAddress: Azcuénaga 1077, 5º A y 4º D, Recoleta, C1115AAK CABA; also M.T. de Alvear 2345, 1º A
clinics.bookingLead: WhatsApp or phone; they assign sede and specialist the same day.
clinics.bestFor: A large Recoleta clinic for implants, orthodontics, and same-day emergencies without a referral.
clinics.notes: Two Recoleta offices and 30+ specialists since 2014. Strongest single-location Google volume after SISO.
clinics.caution: Spanish-only site. Some foreign patients report high quotes. Closed Sundays.

englishSupport.label: Review-only English
englishSupport.evidence: English Google reviews from travelers; /en returns 404.

clinics.insuranceNote: Mostly private. William Hope convenio. Invoices for prepaga reintegro — confirm on WhatsApp.

clinics.name: Dental Arcos
clinics.bookingLead: WhatsApp is the main path; phone and the site form also work.
clinics.bestFor: A compact Palermo multi-specialty clinic with a perfect Google score and Straumann implants.
clinics.notes: Named specialists with Argentine license numbers. 5.0 from 74 Google reviews. Staff English appears in reviews, not on the site.
clinics.caution: No Doctoralia listing and no published prepaga list. Confirm coverage before booking.

englishSupport.label: Staff English in reviews
englishSupport.evidence: Google reviews say doctors and staff communicate in English. Official site is Spanish-only.

clinics.insuranceNote: Treat as private-pay unless the clinic confirms a prepaga.

clinics.name: Tu Sonrisa
clinics.fullAddress: Av. Sta. Fe 2755, Piso 8, Recoleta, C1425 CABA, Argentina
clinics.bookingLead: WhatsApp for routine visits; phone is reserved for emergencies.
clinics.bestFor: High-volume Recoleta clinic for aligners, digital diagnostics, and Sunday appointments.
clinics.notes: Largest Google review count on this page. Sunday hours are useful. No official English.
clinics.caution: 11,000+ Google reviews is unusually high — treat the volume as a popularity signal, not a quality guarantee. Some reviews mention long waits.

englishSupport.label: No official English found
englishSupport.evidence: Website, Instagram, and sampled reviews are Spanish-only.

clinics.insuranceNote: Mostly private-pay. Social comments mention Swiss Medical and Nobis — verify before the visit.

clinics.name: Drs. Pelcman
clinics.fullAddress: Av. Sta. Fe 3444 10A, C1425 CABA, Argentina
clinics.bookingLead: WhatsApp, phone, or the English contact form.
clinics.bestFor: Implants, All-on-X, and aesthetic work for international patients who want an English-first clinic.
clinics.notes: 40+ years at Santa Fe 3444. Dr. Samuel Pelcman holds UBA and California DDS degrees; sons Félix Martín and Nicole practice with him.
clinics.caution: Private-pay. Google review volume is modest. Hours are not always published as a fixed schedule.

englishSupport.label: Official English care
englishSupport.evidence: Full English site with an International Patients section; reviews confirm fluent English.

clinics.insuranceNote: Private-pay. Long-standing ACA member dental agreement. No prepagas listed.

clinics.name: Dr. Isaac Meta
clinics.fullAddress: Av. Raúl Scalabrini Ortiz 2089, Apt 8-30, C1425 CABA, Argentina
clinics.bookingLead: Appointment only — WhatsApp, phone, or email.
clinics.bestFor: A U.S.-trained boutique dentist for implants, periodontics, and embassy-referred expats.
clinics.notes: UBA DDS and Ohio State MS. Listed on the U.S. Embassy medical-providers list. English-first apartment office.
clinics.caution: Private-only and 18 Google reviews. This is a consultorio, not a multi-chair clinic.

englishSupport.label: Official English care
englishSupport.evidence: English website and FAQ state all communication is in English; also speaks Hebrew.

clinics.insuranceNote: Private patients only. Doctoralia says no obras sociales or prepagas.

clinics.name: Enjoy Dental
clinics.fullAddress: Viamonte 1526 5to Piso, C1055 ABB CABA, Argentina
clinics.bookingLead: WhatsApp is the primary channel; phone and the site form also work.
clinics.bestFor: A downtown multi-specialty clinic that actually lists OSDE, Swiss Medical, Galeno, and Medicus.
clinics.notes: Six consultorios and an on-site radiology suite, led by Dra. Silvina Alperin. One of the few ranked clinics with a public prepaga list.
clinics.caution: 4.3 from 358 reviews, including a detailed English complaint about a filling. Site is Spanish-only.

englishSupport.label: English reviews only
englishSupport.evidence: English Google reviews exist. Official site has no English version.

clinics.insuranceNote: OSDE, Galeno, Swiss Medical, Medicus, Apross, OSPJN, plus particulares. Confirm the procedure.

clinics.name: Hospital Alemán — Odontología
clinics.bookingLead: Tu Portal or 4827-7000. Foreigners should email the international desk first.
clinics.bestFor: In-hospital dentistry, bucomaxilofacial surgery, and patients with premium prepagas or foreign insurance.
clinics.notes: JCI hospital with 35+ listed dentists and a bilingual international desk. Not limited to the hospital’s own Plan Médico.
clinics.caution: Google 3.7 is the hospital, not the dental desk. Dental turnos can wait months. Fees are high.

englishSupport.label: Official bilingual desk
englishSupport.evidence: Pacientes Internacionales page describes a dedicated bilingual team.

clinics.insuranceNote: Particular plus OSDE, Medifé Oro+, Swiss Medical, Galeno, Omint, Medicus, Sancor. Confirm dental benefits.

clinics.name: Dental Soho
clinics.bookingLead: WhatsApp or phone; Saturday slots are available.
clinics.bestFor: A bilingual Palermo Soho clinic for general dentistry, implants, and traveler cleanings.
clinics.notes: Dra. Jessica Sommer is the English-speaking name on ExpatsBA. Instagram and Linktree both say the office is bilingual.
clinics.caution: No public prepaga list. One Google review alleges a whitening pricing dispute.

englishSupport.label: Official bilingual clinic
englishSupport.evidence: Instagram bio: 'Bilingual office, we speak in English!'; ExpatsBA recommends Dra. Jessica Sommer.

clinics.insuranceNote: No obra social or prepaga list published. Cards and NFC only — confirm coverage.

clinics.name: One Dental Recoleta
clinics.bookingLead: Google Calendar on the site, or WhatsApp. A transfer deposit confirms the slot.
clinics.bestFor: A Recoleta aesthetic-functional clinic that advertises English on the homepage.
clinics.notes: Homepage says Speak English / Español. Consultation listed at ARS 15,000 including one x-ray.
clinics.caution: Private-pay. Google Business listing looked unclaimed during research. Review volume is moderate.

englishSupport.label: Official English claim
englishSupport.evidence: Homepage and Google description say Speak English / Español; owner replies to English reviews in English.

clinics.insuranceNote: No obras sociales or prepagas listed. Cards, transfer discount, and Mercado Pago installments.

clinics.name: Centro Odontológico Alexis Chudnovsky
clinics.fullAddress: Cdad. de la Paz 1679 1º A, C1426 AHE CABA, Argentina
clinics.bookingLead: WhatsApp to Paula at reception; every site CTA goes there.
clinics.bestFor: Integral aesthetic rehab and implants via the in-house PLAINPRO plan in Belgrano.
clinics.notes: Prof. Dr. Alexis Chudnovsky’s ~30-year Belgrano center with digital planning and on-site prosthetic labs.
clinics.caution: Spanish-only. One review flagged an expensive consult. No obras sociales listed.

englishSupport.label: No official English found
englishSupport.evidence: centroach.com/en/ returns 404. Site and sampled reviews are Spanish-only.

clinics.insuranceNote: Private-pay focus. Cards and payment plans on Google Maps. Confirm fees on WhatsApp.

clinics.name: Like Your Dentist
clinics.bookingLead: WhatsApp first. Walk-ins are welcome if you message before arriving.
clinics.bestFor: Travelers and expats who need same-day English emergency or short-stay restorative care.
clinics.notes: English-first clinic since 2012. Drs Carolina Pera, Luciana Luppino, and Stephanie Scanlan. Published prices and Sunday hours.
clinics.caution: Narrower than a full implant/ortho center. No Argentine prepaga coverage.

englishSupport.label: Official English care
englishSupport.evidence: Entire English website; clinic states all dentists are fluent in English and Spanish.

clinics.insuranceNote: Private/out-of-pocket. Issues English invoices for travel-insurance reimbursement.

clinics.name: Estética Dental Madero / Urrutipi
clinics.fullAddress: Olga Cossettini 1660, P.Baja 3, Puerto Madero, C1107 CABA, Argentina
clinics.bookingLead: WhatsApp or the legacy site form.
clinics.bestFor: Puerto Madero cosmetic dentistry and implants if you already know the Urrutipi family.
clinics.notes: Google now lists the same address as Estética Dental Urrutipi. The Madero domain is still live as a legacy brand.
clinics.caution: Brand and hours do not match across sites. About 17% one-star Google reviews. No confirmed English staff.

englishSupport.label: No confirmed English
englishSupport.evidence: Spanish-only site. A dental-tourism page exists, but no English version or confirmed English-speaking staff.

clinics.insuranceNote: No obra social or prepaga listed. Private-pay with cards.

clinics.name: Centro Odontológico Hospital Italiano
clinics.fullAddress: Av. Juan Bautista Alberdi 562, C1424BYS CABA, Argentina
clinics.bookingLead: Plan de Salud members book via Portal de Pacientes. Others try 7079-7777 or WhatsApp.
clinics.bestFor: Hospital Italiano Plan de Salud members who need cartilla dentistry in Caballito.
clinics.notes: CABA dental center for the Italiano Plan de Salud cartilla — not the Córdoba hospital. Specialists usually need a referral.
clinics.caution: Google 1.9 from 99 reviews, mostly wait and reception complaints. Not a walk-in private clinic.

englishSupport.label: Hospital international desk only
englishSupport.evidence: Hospital internacionales facilitators can help in the patient’s language. The odontología page itself is Spanish-only.

clinics.insuranceNote: Built for Hospital Italiano Plan de Salud. Outside-cartilla reintegros are not the model.
